text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Monday it reaffirmed the double-A claims paying ability ratings of ReliaStar Financial Corp's ReliaStar Life Insurance Co and its three wholly owned subsidiaries.
The subsidiaries are Northern Life Insurance Co, ReliaStar United Services Life Insurance Co and ReliaStar Bankers Security Life Insurance Co.
Duff said it also affirmed ReliaStar's senior debt rating of single-A and ReliaStar Financing I preferred stock rating of single-A-minus.
This follows ReliaStar's announcement today that it was acquiring Security-Connecticut Life Insurance Co in a $488 million deal.

"(ReliaStar) will be challenged to successfully integrate the two companies' operations, and achieve expense savings approximating 15 percent of (Security-Connecticut's) current operating expense, but (ReliaStar's) management has proven ability in this regard, with its USLICO acquisition two years ago," Duff said.
